# CANDIDATE: VWAP_OVERNIGHT_GRINDER_TOP_KEEPER

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** quality_gate  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture overnight VWAP-driven momentum or mean-reversion patterns by combining VWAP reclaim/rejection signals with volume filters, body minimum requirements, and ribbon agreement conditions. The edge may exist due to institutional overnight imbalances that persist into the morning session, creating short-term directional bias exploitable with tight risk controls.

## Mechanism

Entry triggers when: (1) price reclaims or rejects the prior session's VWAP within proximity_dollars, (2) volume exceeds vol_mult × 20-bar average volume, (3) candle body exceeds body_min_cents, (4) EMA ribbon shows agreement (if require_ribbon_agreement=true) with spread ≥ ribbon_min_spread_cents. Exit uses profit-lock at profit_lock_threshold_pct with stop offset profit_lock_stop_offset_pct, TP1 at tp1_premium_pct (qty fraction tp1_qty_fraction), and runner target at runner_target_pct. Position size is qty contracts with strike_offset from ATM.
